newDescription: User story As a Customer Administrator, when the CID???s registration and management traffic is handled, I want it to go to an GenericQA-owned hostname (e.g., api.cid.GenericQA.com ) instead of hub-ac-registration-api.prd-51.aws.GenericQA.com so that my firewall allow-list contains only vendor-controlled GenericQA domains and no internal environment naming (prd-51) is exposed to security review. As a Customer Administrator, when a new CID is activated or an existing CID is updated, I want the registration and management API to work on the new GenericQA domain so that the product stays shippable and self-consistent after this story alone. Context The registration and management API is the CID???s first and most frequent contact point. It is used for activation, registration, and fetching the install script. This work migrates the endpoint, device configuration, and customer-visible checkers end-to-end. Acceptance criteria A new CID activates and registers using only the new GenericQA-domain registration hostname. No connection to the legacy hostname is required. An in-field CID (FR1.0 or later) reaches the registration/management API on the new hostname after installing the Linux Update. No manual reconfiguration or re-registration is needed. The TLS certificate presented on the new hostname is issued under an GenericQA-controlled chain or a public CA bound to the GenericQA domain. It is not a default AWS-managed certificate. The Health Page and the CID Connectivity Tester tests for registration are consolidated to tests to GenericQA. The online help entry for this endpoint lists the new hostname and the Linux Update version it requires. The legacy hostname continues to work for CIDs that have not yet installed the Linux Update. Design Notes Terraform for the custom domain and certificate. Config update, ac_install.sh, and Linux Update deliver the new hostname to devices. Do not remove or redirect the legacy endpoint in this story. Retirement is out of scope until fleet adoption is confirmed. The install-script download URL served to new customers must also move to the new hostname. Health page will update only Registration API as part of this story QA Notes Activate a factory-fresh CID behind a firewall that allows only the new GenericQA hostname, with the legacy hostname blocked. Registration and activation complete. Upgrade an FR1.0-era CID via Linux Update. Verify with DNS, packet capture, or CID logs that registration traffic now targets the new hostname, and confirm no fallback connections to the legacy hostname occur. Regression: a not-yet-updated CID still registers via the legacy hostname. Confirm the Health Page and Connectivity Tester rows are consolidated into GenericQA domain.
